feed.title: /dev/real - Terminal tools for real sustained development.
feed.subtitle: Rooted in the Unix philosophy, /dev/real publishes tools that are minimal and composable. But we’re not just preserving old patterns — we’re exploring new ones. Our aim is to invent modern, efficient workflows that live in the terminal: fast, scriptable, transparent, and distraction-free. No layers you didn’t ask for. No surprises. Just real tools for real work.
